arguments.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise concept revision. Create ONE single high-fidelity 16:9 landscape image of a Chinese 3D campus investment exhibition dashboard. Requested application viewport is 1920x1080; compose for that ratio. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, existing B campus concept; image 2 is a SUPPORTING ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY reference for A1, not another layout to copy. Preserve B's warm-ivory editorial left rail and large right architectural scene, sophisticated restrained architectural visualization, teal accents and same project identity. This is a FICTIONAL demonstration campus in Wuhan Optics Valley, no web case references or real-world geography. Make the following corrections visibly, not just a color change.

1. LIGHTING: Replace heavy yellow golden-hour lighting with clean neutral soft daylight under a very pale blue lightly clouded sky. Neutral pearl-gray stone, blue-gray glazing, realistic silver mullions, muted bronze facade fins; bronze must NOT glow orange. Natural soft green foliage, moderate soft shadows and balanced exposure, almost no glowing windows. Background is low-detail desaturated contextual urban masses. No blown white sky, neon, holograms, bloom or atmospheric yellow haze.

2. EIGHT VERIFIED SUBJECTS: Whole bounded campus parcel and ALL EXACTLY EIGHT primary buildings fit completely in the right 70% of screen, with generous margin away from left UI and image edges. Camera slightly farther than target so missing C3 is a real visible building, not merely a new label. Three rear towers with five clearly lower detached research buildings around one central green court, separated footprints:
rear row from left to right A1, B1, B2;
middle row left A2 and right B3, with green court between;
front row from left to right C1, C2, C3.
A1 has its tower and 3-level stepped podium as ONE compound building. Each remaining ID also refers to exactly ONE visible detached footprint. Every footprint must be countable. Do not add a ninth unlabelled building or make tiny service sheds count as C3. Street boundary clearly distinguishes these eight from faint city context. No pools or new stadium-like features. Sophisticated but buildable landscaping, fewer cars and trees than target. Each building gets ONE clean label attached with a short leader, all labels legible, exactly: "A1 科创大厦", "B1", "B2", "A2", "B3", "C1", "C2", "C3". Arrange labels to avoid overlap or concealment. Teal fine-outline selection only on A1, without cyan neon halo.

3. A1 IDENTITY: A slender rectangular blue-gray glass office tower with exactly THREE podium terrace levels stepping inward; the tower ABOVE the podium has 21 storeys, making 24 levels in total (NOT 24 plus a podium). One vertical muted bronze-fin wall runs along the RIGHT facade; a roof garden is inset under the fin crown. Preserve the essential building in the supporting reference but simplify inconsistent podium steps into exactly three real tiers. Tower-to-podium scale remains elegant, real office architecture and clear curtain-wall divisions. Do not exaggerate tiny facade detail; consistent proportions for later close-up.

4. LEFT RAIL: roughly 26% of width, ivory opaque readable background, little vertical gray rules and restrained teal icons. Plenty of breathing room. Render Chinese text accurately. Header exact "高新区数字楼宇"; subheading "武汉 · 光谷"; visible badge "示范园区 · 演示数据"; small version "B · 修订版 v2". Top two-by-two KPI cards ONLY these values: "楼宇总数" "8 栋", "建筑面积" "24 万㎡", "出租率" "84%", "入驻企业" "216 家".
Industry module MUST be headed "产业方向", with three simple equal-weight category rows "软件研发", "光电子信息", "企业服务"; small caption "示范产业定位". NO bars, percentages, sector counts, false precision, company names, or invented data.
Compact bottom card headed "A1 科创大厦", with plain lines "24 层 · 4.8 万㎡" and "出租率 90% · 入驻企业 42 家". Do NOT insert a separate photo or duplicate 3D building thumbnail inside this card, since it would introduce a competing architectural reference. No construction year or building height field.
Bottom navigation has "园区总览" selected and "重点楼宇" inactive, clearly inside the safe margin and not on top of any building.

Avoid adding more business modules or tiny random text. Preserve original B's tasteful architectural exhibition mood and single-left-rail composition, but fix actual eight-object spatial structure and data semantics. No room/floor interiors, alarm, energy, video or fake realtime timestamps. This is a crisp practical concept screen, not a real-estate poster.

Use case: ui-mockup, precise concept revision. Create ONE single edge-to-edge 16:9 landscape image of the B selected-building dashboard, designed for a 1920x1080 application viewport.
Input image roles: Image 1 (B-building-v1) is the EDIT TARGET for its single left information rail and full-height A1 architectural portrait composition. Image 2 (B-campus-v2) is the AUTHORITATIVE ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY, lighting, palette and campus context reference. The new building MUST be the selected A1 in image 2, its muted bronze-fin RIGHT facade, blue-gray curtain wall, exact podium/roof silhouette and common campus. Do not blindly copy the older taller or more complex form of image 1. This is a fictional demonstration campus, not real geographic data.
Preserve B's sophisticated ivory architectural-exhibition interface, large building on right and concentrated information rail on left. Show full tower AND ground-level podium in frame with margin, occupy right 70% screen, pleasantly low three-quarter camera from the central court toward A1, see its principal glass facade and bronze right fins. Keep architectural proportions credible, detailed curtain wall and terraces, no game forms.
A1 ARCHITECTURE: one rectangular tower on exactly THREE stepped podium terrace levels. 24 TOTAL storeys comprise 3 podium floors + 21 tower floors above the podium; NOT 24 plus podium. Planted inset flat roof with thin bronze crown on right, clean blue-gray glazing, restrained silver mullions, no giant glowing strip. Both sides of podium have three terraces instead of many randomly generated shelves. Surrounding buildings are only low-contrast contextual glimpses, consistent with campus image 2, no arbitrary relocated adjacent landmark towers and no new business objects. Do not add a duplicate building photo or thumbnail inside the rail.
LIGHTING correction: match clean neutral soft DAYLIGHT of image 2. Very light blue sky, pearl-gray stone, blue-gray glass with moderate reflections, muted natural green trees, soft but legible shadows. No sunset yellow, orange glowing bronze, bright illuminated interiors, golden fog, bloom, blown sky or halo. Fine teal focus accents, no neon outlines needed on the whole tower.
UI exact text and hierarchy, use crisply readable Chinese:
Header "高新区数字楼宇", subheading "武汉 · 光谷", badge "示范园区 · 演示数据", small version "B · 修订版 v2".
Breadcrumb "园区总览 / 重点楼宇". Heading "A1 科创大厦".
Four compact cards in a 2x2 grid ONLY these A1 values:
"楼层数" "24 层"; "建筑面积" "4.8 万㎡"; "出租率" "90%"; "入驻企业" "42 家".
Then a compact module "空间利用": an ACCURATE 90%-filled straight teal progress bar (90% fill, 10% light gray remainder) headed "出租率 90%". Immediately underneath, clean readable rows "已租面积 3.6 万㎡", "可租面积 4.0 万㎡", "可租空置面积 0.4 万㎡". These amounts are consistent: 3.6/4.0=90%. Do not use the words 建筑高度 or construction year, do not label a percentage as an area.
Next module title MUST be "入驻产业" (NOT 入驻企业). Three simple equal-weight categories, no invented counts or proportions: "软件研发", "光电子信息", "企业服务". This describes industry types and does not claim these labels are individual company names.
Compact "配套服务" row with restrained pictograms and ONLY "会议空间", "停车服务", "通勤配套". No quantities or destinations.
Bottom-left obvious "返回园区" button. Right scene label only "A1 科创大厦" if useful, no repeated big text covering the facade.
Use tidy typography and generous spacing with a soft ivory left rail approximately 27% of width, teal #277D78, dark ink text #123B40 and fine gray rules. Arrange modules to fit comfortably, reducing ornamental icon size and card padding if needed, not body text size. No crowded huge spaces between tiny modules. No new charts, alarms, energy, rooms, live connection tags or timestamps.
Goal is a coherent corrected B concept, faithful to the same A1 in the corrected overview, neutral daylight and semantically correct content.

Edit ONLY the space-utilization progress bar on this existing concept image. Preserve the rest of the image exactly: same full 16:9 canvas, architecture, camera, title, KPI cards, all Chinese text, landscaping, lighting, ivory panel, colors and button positions. The building, facade and every other module must not be redesigned. In the left sidebar under the heading “空间利用”, REMOVE the horizontal teal/gray progress bar entirely (its drawn fill was inaccurate). Replace ONLY that one row with plain text laid out neatly: label “出租率” on left, value “90%” aligned right, with a fine light-gray horizontal separator underneath, consistent with the three amount rows below. No quantitative bar, pie chart or extra icon on this row. Keep the three rows below EXACTLY “已租面积 3.6 万㎡”, “可租面积 4.0 万㎡”, “可租空置面积 0.4 万㎡”. Keep all other data and the modules 入驻产业、配套服务 unchanged. Do not invent a replacement chart. This is a surgical UI correction; maintain all remaining pixels and composition as closely as possible. Output one corrected full landscape image.
